about: Platform IMU mount calibration (IDEA-20, Rung P5). Measured, hand-readable, committed. Read by teensy_link/platform_imu_mount.py and the GUI IMU routes; NOT generated by config/generate_config.py. Raw capture files on disk stay in the IMU frame; this file is applied at read time only.

rotation.name: R_PI
rotation.direction: IMU frame to Platform frame: v_platform = R_PI @ v_imu, for a column vector. Row i of the matrix holds the IMU-frame components of Platform axis i.
rotation.frame_convention: Platform frame: x, y, z of the Platform body, z up when Level (axes as the Jog Tilt buttons use: Rx +5 is a right-handed 5 degree rotation about Platform x). IMU frame: the chip axes as the accel_g / gyro_dps arrays carry them. The accelerometer reports specific force, so a still Platform reads about (0, 0, +1 g) in the Platform frame after rotation (the IMU x axis points up, at the board's 3 degree tilt).
rotation.cad_nominal_in_words: IMU x = Platform +z, IMU y = Platform -x, IMU z = Platform -y.

deviation_from_cad_deg.note: R_PI = Exp(delta) @ R_nominal, delta as a rotation vector about Platform (x, y, z), degrees.

gyro_bias.units: degrees per second, IMU frame, as read with the Platform still (mean of the Level window)
gyro_bias.caveat: A single-Sitting value at one chip temperature (24.0 C at both freezes on 2026-11-22); the bias drifts with temperature and is NOT subtracted by the loader or the GUI.

accelerometer.magnitude_g_at_rest: 0.9996 to 1.0000 over the still windows (within -0.04 percent of 1 g); no scale correction is applied.

lever_arm_mm.frame: Platform frame, IMU chip position relative to the Platform origin
lever_arm_mm.note: The Sitting's Jog moves could not fit it (R2 0.13). Not applied by anything yet.

provenance.capture_note: Fit windows are inside 572E only: Level = the post-Tilt Home hold, 6.0 s; Rx +5, 6.6 s; Ry +5, 7.1 s. 572D (Active pose, not Level) only cross-checks it (residual 0.020 deg). Both captures: 32000 samples, FW 13, 1 kHz, CRC checked and OK, 0 FIFO overflows, 0 I2C errors.
provenance.method: Wahba fit (scipy Rotation.align_vectors) of the three still-window mean accelerometer vectors (Level, Rx +5, Ry +5) to their reference gravity directions in the Platform frame (reference C: commanded Jog targets through the levelling correction).
provenance.fit_residual_deg: 0.007 to 0.013 at the three fit windows; leave-one-out at most 0.032

level_definition: Level is the Jog Home pose: commanded identity orientation through the levelling correction (inclinometer offset plus level trim 0.38 deg, see ros_ws/docs/levelling_frame.md). The held Active pose is NOT Level (it sits 0.6 deg off, map BUG-130), so the dedicated Active-pose capture was not used as a Level reference.

accuracy.tilt_note: About Platform x and y: set by the Level definition (trim or no trim moves the fit 0.38 deg) plus the unmeasured accelerometer zero-g offset (0.057 deg per mg). The 0.01 deg fit residual does not describe this.
accuracy.yaw_note: About Platform z, plus or minus; set only by the 5 deg Tilt difference vectors (0.65 deg by reference C, 0.29 by Mocap).
